what.zh: TabbyAPI 以模型目录名对外；这个名字只用于平台的实例标签和统计。
what.en: TabbyAPI lists the model by its folder name; this name is used only for the platform's instance labels and statistics.

what.zh: TabbyAPI 从 api_tokens.yml 读取密钥。平台为本次启动生成该文件（仅当前用户可读），实例停止时删除。必须设置。
what.en: TabbyAPI reads its keys from api_tokens.yml. The platform writes that file for this launch (readable by the current user only) and deletes it when the instance stops. A key is required.

what.zh: 写入 config.yml 的 draft_model.draft_model_dir 和 draft_model_name；必须是 EXL3 草稿模型。
what.en: Written to draft_model.draft_model_dir and draft_model_name in config.yml; it must be an EXL3 draft model.

summary.zh: TabbyAPI 的 KV 缓存量化：FP16、Q8、Q6 或 Q4。
summary.en: TabbyAPI's KV cache quantization: FP16, Q8, Q6 or Q4.

what.zh: 写入 config.yml 的 model.cache_mode。留空时用 TabbyAPI 默认值（FP16）。
what.en: Written to model.cache_mode in config.yml. Empty uses TabbyAPI's default (FP16).

whenToChange.zh: 需要更长上下文而显存不够时选 Q8 或 Q6。
whenToChange.en: Choose Q8 or Q6 when you need a longer context than memory allows.

tradeoffs.zh: 越低越省显存，但可能轻微影响质量。
tradeoffs.en: Lower precision saves memory but can slightly reduce quality.

summary.zh: TabbyAPI 预分配的 KV 缓存 token 数，所有并发请求共用。
summary.en: The number of tokens of KV cache TabbyAPI allocates up front, shared by all concurrent requests.

what.zh: 写入 config.yml 的 model.cache_size。留空时等于上下文长度。显存准入按权重加上这部分 KV 估算。
what.en: Written to model.cache_size in config.yml. Empty equals the context length. VRAM admission estimates the weights plus this KV cache.

whenToChange.zh: 要同时服务多个请求时，设为上下文长度的倍数。
whenToChange.en: Set it to a multiple of the context length to serve several requests at once.

summary.zh: 把模型的每一层切分到所选的所有 GPU 上。
summary.en: Split every layer across all selected GPUs.

what.zh: 写入 config.yml 的 model.tensor_parallel。关闭时 TabbyAPI 按层分配 GPU。
what.en: Written to model.tensor_parallel in config.yml. Off lets TabbyAPI place whole layers on separate GPUs.

whenToChange.zh: 多张 GPU 之间有高速互联，想加快单个请求时。
whenToChange.en: When several GPUs have fast links and you want faster single requests.

tradeoffs.zh: 需要 GPU 间带宽，并非所有模型架构都支持。
tradeoffs.en: It needs inter-GPU bandwidth and not every architecture supports it.

label.zh: 自动分配 GPU 显存

summary.zh: 让 TabbyAPI 自动决定每张 GPU 加载多少层。
summary.en: Let TabbyAPI decide how much of the model each GPU holds.

whenToChange.zh: 只有想手工划分显存时才关闭。
whenToChange.en: Turn it off only to split memory by hand.

tradeoffs.zh: 关闭后需要自己在配置里给出分配，平台目前没有这个入口。
tradeoffs.en: Off needs a manual split in the config, which the platform has no field for yet.
